notes: One entry per (adapter, width, batch) the crossover was measured at. `route` is the graph that won there: `staged` is the composed graph (the tuned module followed by the fused key/state kernels) and `fused` is the single fused producer. `candidates` holds the measured median milliseconds of every candidate the sweep ran, and the loader refuses an entry whose route is not the fastest candidate it lists, so a hand-edited entry has to contradict its own measurement to load. An entry may carry `parameter_storage` to scope it to one storage policy (see `validation/FUSED_FORWARD_PRODUCER_AUDIT.md`); the policy-less entry is what every other policy reads. A geometry measured inside the 2% noise band is a tie and carries no entry at all: the driver withdraws any entry it finds there and the structural default decides that geometry until a quiet run measures a sign outside the band. Re-record a new adapter's own entries with `--record-decisions`.
